questions.question: Do concepts without an implementation get entries?
questions.explanation: spec-interviewer.md is deliberately empty ('what the next launch builds', STRUCTURE.md) and 7 of 13 crew.json roles exist only as manifest nodes (orchestrator, explorer, interface-builder, worker-strong, unit-adversary, run-verifier, report-assembler). The library documents best practice for the pattern; whether an entry needs a local implementation to point at is undecided. The byte-identical duplication between .claude/agents/ and flightdeck/flightcrew/crew/ is a related documentation question.
options: Yes — an entry covers the concept's practice regardless of local implementation; missing implementations are noted in the entry's unresolved field
No — only implemented components get entries; the rest wait
Stub entries: listed in the index with key terms and power statement only, completed when implemented
questions.recommendation: Yes — the library records practice, not repo state; the practice for an orchestrator exists in the sources whether or not orchestrator.md does.
